answer: A biometric uniqueness registry stops sybils at the root. First, each agent submits a zero-knowledge proof of a live, unique biometric; no raw data leaves its device. Second, the registry stores only a hash and rejects duplicates, so one person cannot mint thousands of agents. Third, identities re-prove liveness every 90 days or lose rights. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 live people and about $2,000,000 in recruitment and spoof gear. Like a trellis letting one vine per opening, and a beacon on a mesa marking a single gate, it admits one real identity per person.
